vcu_g_0159_20001490.name: upgrade_flags
vcu_g_0159_20001490.description: Firmware-upgrade session flags and sequence byte at RAM 0x20001490 (struct UpgradeFlags). Driven by vcu_fw_update_frame_handler and cleared by vcu_crypto_key_load. Bytes 0x20001496 to 0x20001499 are not part of this object.

vcu_g_0159_2000149c.name: upgrade_xfer
vcu_g_0159_2000149c.description: Firmware-transfer size, progress, checksum, block count and the 8-byte chain and block words at RAM 0x2000149C (struct UpgradeXfer). Driven by vcu_fw_update_frame_handler and cleared by vcu_crypto_key_load.

vcu_g_153_200014a0.name: upgrade_progress_checksum_b153
vcu_g_153_200014a0.description: Build-153 layout of the progress and checksum words of UpgradeSession: element 0 is the bytes-accepted counter (probably the same role as xfer_progress, which the version tracker places at another address in 153), element 1 is the rolling checksum (same role as checksum). Both are cleared by vcu_crypto_key_load.

vcu_g_14b_20002041.name: upgrade_cfg_b14b
vcu_g_14b_20002041.description: Two bytes read by vcu_fw_update_frame_handler in build 14b only. They are probably product or board options, and nothing writes them in this packet.

vcu_g_14e_20002041.name: upgrade_cfg_b14e
vcu_g_14e_20002041.description: Two bytes read by vcu_fw_update_frame_handler in build 14e only. They are probably product or board options, and nothing writes them in this packet.

vcu_g_14f_20002041.name: upgrade_cfg_b14f
vcu_g_14f_20002041.description: Two bytes read by vcu_fw_update_frame_handler in build 14f only. They are probably product or board options, and nothing writes them in this packet.

vcu_g_0159_200020dc.name: upgrade_tea_key
vcu_g_0159_200020dc.description: 16-byte key used to decrypt each 8-byte update block, probably XTEA. vcu_crypto_key_load loads it from flash 0x08001440 or the built-in default. vcu_fw_update_frame_handler adds the block index to one byte of it every 1 KiB. The key bytes are secret and are deliberately not recorded here.

vcu_g_0159_200020ec.name: upgrade_block_copy
vcu_g_0159_200020ec.description: Copy of the received frame that vcu_fw_update_frame_handler makes before checking the first 1 KiB against the product block at 0x08001400. Byte 5 of the frame is at 0x200020F1. Only the first 8 bytes are described here; the copy may be longer.

vcu_g_152_200020f9.name: upgrade_cfg_b152
vcu_g_152_200020f9.description: Two bytes read by vcu_fw_update_frame_handler in build 152 only. Probably product or board options.

vcu_g_153_20002101.name: upgrade_cfg_b153
vcu_g_153_20002101.description: Two bytes read by vcu_fw_update_frame_handler in build 153 only. Probably product or board options.

vcu_g_148_20002119.description: Two bytes read by vcu_fw_update_frame_handler in build 148 only. Probably product or board options.

vcu_g_0159_20002121.name: upgrade_ident_ram
vcu_g_0159_20002121.description: 16-byte RAM copy that vcu_fw_update_frame_handler compares with the identifier at flash 0x08001430 at the first 1 KiB boundary. The contents are the device identifier, which is not secret.

vcu_g_0159_20002131.name: upgrade_key_ram_copy
vcu_g_0159_20002131.description: 16-byte RAM copy that vcu_fw_update_frame_handler compares with the key at flash 0x08001440 at the first 1 KiB boundary. The bytes are secret and are deliberately not recorded here.
